description: Entirely synthetic conversation and questions about a fictional project, Orchard. No real person, company or fact is described. Use it only to check the harness; real measurement needs a private fixture made from real early facts after some real use.
summary:
## Conversation summary (synthetic, frozen)
- Working on the fictional project Orchard with the dot.
- The design system is named Quince.
- The incident channel is #orchard-fire.
- Status updates should be bullet points.
- Routine requests about the calendar, replies and reminders.

messages.text: The staging database for Orchard is called pear-staging.
We picked Fastify over Express for the Orchard API.
The Orchard launch date is the 14th of March.
Invoices must be kept for seven years.
I prefer weekly summaries on Friday afternoons.
Never schedule meetings before 10am for me.
The design system is named Quince.
Rate limits for the public API are 600 requests per minute.
We decided to drop support for Internet Explorer.
The mobile app will use React Native, not Flutter.
Our on-call rotation changes every Tuesday.
The quarterly offsite is in Lisbon this year.
Use the plum bucket for analytics exports.
Feature flags live in LaunchDarkly project orchard-flags.
The search index rebuild runs nightly at 02:30.
We agreed the error budget is 0.5 percent per month.
I'm allergic to peanuts, remember for team lunches.
The customer pilot is with Brightwater Logistics.
Budget for contractors is capped at 30k per quarter.
The old CRM gets switched off on June 30th.
We will write release notes in Notion, not Confluence.
Password rotation for service accounts happens every 90 days.
Kenji is the security reviewer for Orchard.
The data warehouse moved to Snowflake in spring.
I want code reviews within one business day.
The pricing page experiment uses three tiers.
Open question: should Orchard support SSO at launch?
The demo account email is demo@orchard.example.
The design review happens on alternate Wednesdays.
We committed to a 99.9 percent uptime SLA.
Lunch-and-learn talks are recorded and kept for a year.
The Orchard logo color is deep teal.
Backups are tested on the first Monday of each month.
I'd like status updates in bullet points, not paragraphs.
The partner API key belongs to the integrations team.
Mobile releases go out every other Thursday.
We chose Postgres 17 for the new ledger service.
